edits.old_string: On the ruling it lands at once on its own branch, its diff operator-approved, through `crucible:finishing-a-development-branch`.

note: Binding-change paragraph: the ruling now also decides whether the change takes a campaign (pointer to umbrellas.md § Review), and landing waits for that campaign where one is taken.
